backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining the booking system backend with types for services, bookings, and user profiles, plus CRUD endpoints (createBooking, getAllBookings, deleteAllBookings, user profile management) protected by role-based access control.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented feature IDs (animated hero canvas, spiritual quiz, booking counter badge, testimonials carousel, etc.) to their corresponding source files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-to-two sentence summaries of every frontend source file, serving as a reference index for the project's frontend codebase.
frontend/index.css: Root CSS entry point that imports Tailwind base/components/utilities and defines CSS custom property tokens for light and dark themes (colors, radius, chart, sidebar variables).
frontend/index.html: HTML shell with comprehensive SEO meta tags, Open Graph/Twitter card tags, structured JSON-LD LocalBusiness schema, and canonical URL targeting the Omm Vedic Numerloggy ICP app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with two routes: '/' rendering HomePage and '/admin' rendering AdminPage.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminAnaly: Admin analytics panel that computes and displays total, pending, and confirmed booking counts, the most recent booking date, and a per-service bar chart from a passed bookings array.
frontend/src/components/admin/BookingsTa: Renders a responsive table (desktop) and card list (mobile) of bookings with formatted service type, category, date, time, and status columns. Shows an empty state message when no bookings exist.
frontend/src/components/booking/BookingF: A multi-step booking form (3 steps: service selection, personal details, schedule) that submits a booking via a mutation hook and opens a WhatsApp notification to the admin on success.
frontend/src/components/home/AboutSectio: Displays an 'About Us' section with descriptive text about Omm Vedic Numerology and a 2x2 grid of feature cards highlighting Ancient Wisdom, Personalized Guidance, Trusted Practice, and Holistic Approach.
frontend/src/components/home/ContactUsSe: Renders a contact section with a WhatsApp icon, phone number display, and a CTA button linking to the business's WhatsApp for direct customer inquiries.
frontend/src/components/home/DailyCosmic: Displays a daily rotating cosmic tip selected from a hardcoded array based on the day of the year, styled as a decorative quote card with a mandala background.
frontend/src/components/home/FindUsSecti: Renders a location section showing the business's exact address in Bhubaneswar with a Google Maps deep-link CTA button and decorative cosmic styling.
frontend/src/components/home/HeroSection: Hero section component with a canvas-based particle and mandala animation, a parallax scroll effect on desktop, and displays the total booking count fetched via a custom query hook.
frontend/src/components/home/ServiceCard: Renders a single service card with an icon, name, descriptions, fixed ₹400 price, and a 'Book Now' button that triggers the provided callback with the service ID.
frontend/src/components/home/ServicesSec: Displays a grid of all services using ServiceCard components, with a section header and a pricing note footer; accepts an onBookNow callback passed down to each card.
frontend/src/components/home/SpiritualPr: A multi-step quiz component that scores user answers across four questions to recommend the most suitable spiritual service (Numerology, Tarot, Vastu, or Pronology).
frontend/src/components/home/Testimonial: Auto-advancing carousel displaying seven hardcoded client testimonials with star ratings, supporting manual prev/next navigation and pause-on-hover behavior.
frontend/src/components/home/WhyChooseUs: Static section highlighting four SEO-oriented benefit cards (Numerology, Vastu, Tarot, Pronology) positioning the business as Odisha's top spiritual guidance centre.
frontend/src/components/layout/FloatingB: Fixed floating button in the bottom-left corner that opens a pre-filled WhatsApp chat link to book a consultation with Omm Vedic Numerology.
frontend/src/components/layout/FloatingW: Renders a fixed floating WhatsApp button with a pulse animation and SVG icon that links to a specific WhatsApp number.
frontend/src/components/layout/Header.ts: Responsive site header with logo, desktop/mobile navigation links for scrolling to page sections, and a subtle admin panel icon link.
frontend/src/components/layout/MarqueeTi: Displays a horizontally scrolling marquee ticker bar listing services, location, and pricing information with a gold gradient background.
frontend/src/data/services.ts: Defines the ServiceData interface and exports an array of four service objects (Tarot, Numerology, Vastu, Pronology) each priced at ₹400.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, initializing it with the user's Internet Identity or anonymously, and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for admin operations: checking if the caller is an admin, fetching all bookings, and deleting all bookings.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication context and provider using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login, logout, identity, and status state to child components.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for creating a booking (mutation) and fetching the total booking count (query) via the ICP backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet defining a cosmic dark theme with gold accents using Tailwind CSS, custom OKLCH CSS variables, and utility classes for fonts, gradients, glows, and UI components.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page that handles Internet Identity login/logout, displays all bookings in a table with analytics, and provides actions like refresh, delete all bookings, and WhatsApp alerts for pending bookings.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main public-facing homepage that composes all sections (Hero, Services, Quiz, Testimonials, Booking Form, etc.) with smooth-scroll navigation and pre-selected service state passed to the booking form.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for reading URL query parameters from both standard and hash-based routes, with helpers to persist values in sessionStorage and remove sensitive params from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color palettes (cosmic, gold), box shadows, fonts (Cinzel, Cormorant Garamond), and keyframe animations (twinkle, float, marquee, whatsapp-pulse) used throughout the app.
project_state.json: Project state manifest (version 31) describing the Omm Vedic Numerology site's architecture, existing features, known issues (booking form errors, missing admin notifications, time field), and image requirements.
